verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a plausible axis for a package manager and build ecosystem, since some registries issue scoped tokens, so the story applies. Nothing in the evidence describes Nix issuing API credentials or tokens of any kind, scoped or otherwise. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and the multi-user install and per-user profile notes concern software installation, not credentials for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
